𝗧𝗿𝗮𝗳𝗳𝗶𝗰 𝗔𝗱𝘃𝗶𝘀𝗼𝗿𝘆 – 𝗖𝗵𝗮𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗽𝗮𝘁𝗵𝗶 𝗦𝗵𝗶𝘃𝗮𝗷𝗶 𝗝𝗮𝘆𝗮𝗻𝘁𝗵𝗶 (19.02.2026)

In view of Chatrapathi Shivaji Jayanthi on 19th February 2026, a procession will be taken out from Puranapool Darwaza at 11:30 AM to Shivaji Statue (Imlibun), followed by a public meeting. Traffic diversions will be in force from 11:00 AM to 6:00 PM in the areas of Puranapool, Madina, S J Rotary, Afzalgunj and surrounding localities.

𝗧𝗿𝗮𝗳𝗳𝗶𝗰 𝗗𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 & 𝗔𝗹𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝗥𝗼𝘂𝘁𝗲𝘀:

RTC buses from Shamshabad and Attapur towards Puranapool will be diverted at Aramghar towards Chandrayangutta.

Traffic from Aramghar towards Puranapool will be diverted at Bahadurpura X Road towards Kishan Bagh and Kamatipura.

Traffic from Madina towards Bahadurpura will be diverted at Goodwill Café via Parthiwada towards Bahadurpura X Road.

Traffic from City College towards Puranapool will be diverted towards MJ Bridge.

Traffic from 100 Feet Road (Jiyaguda/Karwan) towards Puranapool will be diverted at Puranapool X Road towards Jummerath Bazar – MJ Bridge.

Traffic and RTC buses from S J Rotary towards Shivaji Bridge will be diverted towards Madina – City College – MJ Bridge.

Traffic and RTC buses from CBS towards Shivaji Junction will be diverted at Old RTC Depot Road towards Rangamahal (while procession reaches Shivaji Junction).

Traffic from Afzalgunj – Central Library towards Shivaji Junction will be diverted at Afzalgunj T-Junction towards S A Bazar Mosque.

Traffic from MJ Market towards Afzalgunj will be diverted towards Malakunta – Alaska – Chatri – MJ Bridge (while procession crosses S A Bazar Mosque).

Traffic from Afzalgunj towards MJ Market will be diverted at Afzalgunj T-Junction towards Central Library.

Further, another procession will take place from Hanuman Temple, Moti Nagar to Borabanda Bus Stop between 5:00 PM and 9:00 PM. Congestion is expected at Moti Nagar X Roads and Borabanda Bus Stop during the said hours.

Commuters are advised to avoid the affected routes, plan travel in advance and cooperate with the Hyderabad Traffic Police.
